# Packages whose tests run on the windows-latest job (.github/workflows/windows.yml).
# One package per line; '#' starts a comment. No wildcards ("./...").
# NEVER ./pkg/hub itself (or a ./pkg/hub/... wildcard), and never a package
# whose test binary links pkg/hub: the unsharded pkg/hub test compile needs
# about 12 GiB (the job fails on a ./pkg/hub or ./pkg/hub/... line).
# ./pkg/hub/<sub> packages that do not link pkg/hub are allowed. ./cmd is the
# one exception: its test binary links pkg/hub production code (never pkg/hub's
# tests), as on Linux, and it runs anchored tests only.
# A package left off for a Windows-environment reason gets a one-line reason
# here; nothing is skipped.
# ./pkg/util: anchored to its Windows tests (the full suite is POSIX-bound):
# host git runs no hooks (core.hooksPath=NUL), and RemoveAllSafe fails closed.
./pkg/util -run=^(TestHostGitRunsNoHooksWindows|TestWindowsRemoveSymlinkSafe_FailsClosed|TestWindowsRemoveAllSafe_SymlinkFailsClosed|TestWindowsRemoveAllSafe_NoSymlinkRemoves)$
./pkg/util/privatefs
./pkg/util/pathcanon
./pkg/util/filelock
./pkg/tunnelclient
./pkg/credentials
./pkg/apiclient
# ./pkg/config: anchored to its Windows private-file tests (the full suite
# is POSIX-bound).
./pkg/config -run=^(TestWindowsHubProjectsDir_AliasFormsAreUnder|TestWindowsHubProjectsDir_UnresolvableIsUnder|TestWindowsHubProjectsDir_UnknownHomeIsUnder|TestWindowsHubWorkspace_AliasFormsSkipProjectLayer|TestWindowsHubWorkspace_UnresolvableProjectsDirSkipsProjectLayer|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_PrivateReplacesTooOpenInheritInherits|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_PrivateReplacesSymlinkNotTarget|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_InheritKeepsOwnerOnlyTarget|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_InheritDecisionDoesNotFollowLink|TestWindowsPersistHubID_GlobalDirAndFilePrivate|TestWindowsSettingsLock_RefusesJunctionLockFile|TestWindowsUpdateCLIContext_Private|TestWindowsIntegrationConfig_Private|TestWindowsCurrentUserOwns|TestWindowsMigrateLegacyGlobalLayout_SkipsForeignOwnedEntry|TestWindowsMkdirLikeLegacyRoot_FollowsSourceACL|TestWindowsWriteConflictBackup_Private|TestWindowsCopySettingsBackup_FollowsSourceACL|TestWindowsCopySettingsBackup_DecisionFromReadHandle|TestWindowsProtectionForCheck_FailsClosed|TestWriteConflictBackup_PartialFileRemovedOnFailure)$
# ./pkg/brokercredentials: the Windows-reachable read (the write path and
# multistore are gated).
./pkg/brokercredentials -run=^(TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_RefusesUsersReadableFile|TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_RefusesSymlink|TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_MissingIsNotFound|TestStore_Load|TestStore_LoadNotFound|TestStore_LoadValidation)$
# ./pkg/agent: the GitHub resolution cache, host state, the git base config
# refusal and the state directory removal (no podman unshare retry) only (the
# rest is gated agent provisioning).
./pkg/agent -run=^(TestWindowsResolutionCache_NewDirAndFilePrivate|TestWindowsResolutionCache_RepairsOwnedTooOpenFile|TestWindowsResolutionCache_ForeignOwnedFileWarnedNotRepaired|TestWindowsResolutionCache_TooOpenDirWarnedNotRepaired|TestWindowsHostState_Unsupported|TestWindowsGitBaseConfig_Unsupported|TestWindowsRetryRemovalInUserNamespace_ReturnsOriginal)$
./pkg/hubprofile
# ./pkg/runtime: anchored to the git-metadata bind refusal (the rest is
# broker-side container runtime code).
./pkg/runtime -run=^(TestWindowsGitBindSource_Unsupported|TestWindowsGitBindCallers_RegisterNoMount)$
# ./pkg/brokercontrol: anchored to its Windows tests (the rest needs POSIX
# permissions, symlinks and hard links; the Runtime Broker is gated).
./pkg/brokercontrol -run=^(TestCheck_WindowsVolumeRoot|TestCheck_WindowsCaseVariant|TestCheck_WindowsRelativeDriveForm|TestVolumeAllowed_WindowsCaseVariant|TestVolumeAllowed_CaseVariantRefused)$
# ./cmd: anchored to the Windows-relevant tests (the full suite is
# POSIX-bound). Never the attachment-writing
# message tests.
./cmd -run=^(TestSSHWrite_NewFilePrivate|TestSSHWrite_FollowsUserSymlinkAndRepairsOpenTarget|TestSSHWrite_RefusesForeignWritableParent|TestSSHWrite_RefusesForeignOwnedTarget|TestSSHWrite_RefusesHardLinkedTarget|TestSSHKnownHostsTempFilePrivate|TestSSHShellQuoteForCmd|TestSSHCmdQuote_RefusesShellSpecialChars|TestSSHEndpointURL_RefusesShellSpecialChars|TestSSHWindowsForm_RefusesEndpointShellSpecialChars|TestSSHWindowsForm_RefusesExePathShellSpecialChars|TestRenderSSHHostBlock_WindowsFormEndpointWithPath|TestRenderSSHHostBlock_WindowsFormIPv6Endpoint|TestVSCode_ValidatesArgumentsForCmdLauncher|TestCheckVSCodeBatchArgs|TestPrepareSSH_RefusalMakesNoTempDir|TestVSCodeFiles_PrivateOnWindows|TestLockVSCodeDir_TimesOut|TestLockVSCodeDir_WaitsForRelease|TestLockVSCodeDir_DefaultWait|TestHubTestIdentityOut_DescribesACL|TestResolveBrokerJoinToken_WarnsOnForeignACE|TestWindowsGate_RefusesServerAndBroker|TestWindowsGate_DropsFlagValidationOnGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_RefusesBeforeProjectResolution|TestWindowsGate_HidesOnlyGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_AllowlistEntriesExist|TestWindowsGate_NoopOnUnix|TestWindowsGate_AllowsUseOnlyUnderProject|TestWindowsGate_ClearsPersistentHooksOnGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_RefusesDespitePersistentHook|TestWindowsGate_CompletionSkipsGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_NoPersistentHooksOnAllowedAncestorsOfGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_RefusesUngatePrerequisiteCommands|TestWindowsUse_SelectWritesPrivateContext|TestSSHAndVSCodeFollowLinksOutsideHome|TestSSHDirCallers_ForeignWritableLinkTargetRefused|TestSSHWrite_LinkToForeignOwnedTargetRefused|TestEnsureSSHDir_RefusesInvalidComponents|TestEnsureSSHDir_ShortNameStaysInside|TestSSHVSCodeWriteLeaves_RefuseHardLinks|TestEnsureSSHDirOnlyUsesTheHandleWalk|TestSSHPrepare_SpaceInTempWindows|TestSSHKnownHostsOptionValue|TestSSHDirRelsMatchPaths|TestSSHWrite_WarnsOnMutableLinkTargetParent|TestWriteSSHHubPlan_HardLinkedConfigWithIncludeLineUntouched|TestUpdateVSCodeFiles_HardLinkedSettingsUnchangedUntouched)$

# ./pkg/artifacts: anchored to the reference parsing and encoding that the
# allowlisted message command uses (--artifact); full suite OFF, see below.
./pkg/artifacts -run=^(TestParseRef|TestParseMessageRef|TestParseMessageRefsBoundsAndDedupes|TestEncodeMessageRefsRoundTrip)$
# Left OFF after triage (Windows-environment reasons; nothing is skipped):
# ./deploy/terraform/tools/settingscheck: test-only package (go build refuses it); Terraform deploy tooling, Linux-only.
# ./hack/checktimeliterals: TestScanFixtures scans 11 fixture files instead of 10 on a Windows checkout; Linux-only repo guard.
# ./harnesses: the Python harness tests are POSIX-bound (os.O_DIRECTORY, /run paths, ~ expansion), and the vendored-lib header check fails on a CRLF checkout.
# ./pkg/artifacts (full suite): a testdata fixture compares unequal on a Windows checkout, and TestViewSandboxBrowserProbe skips without Chromium.
# ./pkg/brokerregistration: broker instance-directory locking is unsupported on Windows (the broker is gated on Windows).
# ./pkg/config/pgprovider: every test needs Postgres (-tags integration) and skips without it.
# ./pkg/hub/authzop: the catalog report and mutation-classification guards compare unequal on a Windows checkout; Linux-only hub guard.
# ./pkg/integration/runtime: links pkg/hub production code; server-side integration runtime, not on a windowsAllowed path.
# ./pkg/projectfs/migrate: unix-only package (every file is unix-tagged; hub-side project storage migration).
# ./pkg/k8s: the exec credential plugin test runs a #!/bin/sh script (POSIX-only); the Kubernetes runtime is broker-side.
# ./pkg/preflight: TestProfilesCheck_BeforeViewWithoutRetention reports only dropped_unused_profile (active_profile_fallback missing) and TestProfilesCheck_RealBadSettingsFileNeverQuotesValue reports a warning instead of the undecodable-settings block (hub-side upgrade preflight; follow-up).
# ./pkg/sciontool/autoexpose: TestReconciler_IPv6OnlyListenerRegisteredAsLoopback skips without /proc/net/tcp6 (in-container tool).
# ./pkg/sciontool/conduit: the sciontool agent log cannot be opened on Windows (in-container tool), and the IPv6-only loopback fallback fails.
# ./pkg/sciontool/log: the agent log cannot be opened on Windows by design (openLogFileNoFollow is ErrUnsupported; in-container tool).
# ./pkg/sciontool/suppgroups: the tests do not build for Windows (Linux supplementary groups; in-container tool).
# ./pkg/store/enttest: two Postgres-only tests skip without SCION_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.
# ./pkg/testinfra: TestDelegate_ConcurrentLiveCapHolds_Postgres skips without Postgres.
# ./pkg/wsclient: the pty reconnect tests fail on Windows TCP abort semantics (wsarecv); attach reconnect on Windows is a follow-up.
